author: ViolentBoo
body:
So it's pretty much done!
Download and comparisons with generic RP.

Added color indication for strength of the bow.
Added giant numbers rather than cracks the block break animation.
Fixed glass disapearence at medium distances.
Medpack rather than golden apple.
Clear gui rather than gray (From killerbye's texture.)
Increase brightness of obsidian.

Comparisons: http://youtu.be/z7DzsUs2d2o (Crappy resolution because tried to make a gif out of this :P)

Download: https://www.mediafire.com/?kqqaxqa5k2elg8l
